name: Channels in Chats
author: wizard
description: Chats gets Activity and Channels tabs. Activity is today's list with each chat's channel under its title; Channels shows your Spaces one per line (plus General), and opening one shows its chats as posts with a reply line. Slack-style, phase 1 (wizard-ux issue 1254). On a box with the Agent Service channel store, channels, pins, sort and archive are shared by every device, with Alerts pinned at the top (wizard-ux issue 1261).
